root_cause.text: In inet_csk_listen_stop(), after migrating an established child socket to a new listener's accept queue via inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add(), the code failed to call sk_data_ready() on the target listener, so waiters (e.g., poll, blocking accept) remain asleep indefinitely.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "When inet_csk_listen_stop() migrates an established child socket ... the target listener gets a new accept-queue entry via inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add(), but that path never notifies the target listener's waiters." The patch adds `READ_ONCE(nsk->sk_data_ready)(nsk)` after a successful migration. It also wraps the post-queue_add dereferences in `rcu_read_lock()/rcu_read_unlock()` because the reference is transferred and another CPU could free the listener.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix race condition and missing wakeup by adding RCU protection and invoking sk_data_ready after successful request socket migration.
intent_record.what: Added rcu_read_lock/unlock around the inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add block and a READ_ONCE call to nsk->sk_data_ready on success.
intent_record.how: Protects the critical section with RCU read-side locking to prevent premature freeing, and invokes the data_ready callback after successful migration to notify the socket.
